visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of a white plastic plate containing chopped raw octopus pieces which are visibly squirming. The dish is topped with sesame seeds and sits next to a dollop of red sauce and some dried seaweed flakes. The lighting is bright and industrial, reflecting off the metal table surface. (2) Medium shot of a man in a beige jacket smiling widely at the camera, gesturing with his hands. He is in a busy indoor restaurant with signs in Korean characters in the background and other patrons visible, including a man in a black puffer jacket behind him. (3) The man uses wooden chopsticks to pinch a piece of octopus from the plate; the octopus limb wraps around the chopstick. He brings it close to his face, looking apprehensive yet excited, while his friend in a brown cap watches from the background. (4) The man places the octopus in his mouth and begins chewing vigorously. His eyes widen in surprise as he feels the suction of the tentacles. A text overlay with variety-show style yellow font appears next to his head to emphasize the moment. (5) A very close macro shot of the man's open mouth reveals the greyish octopus piece still pulsing against his teeth and tongue. His skin texture is clear under the harsh overhead lights, and he maintains a wide-eyed, shocked expression while displaying the food. (6) The camera pans to a second man in a brown cap who picks up a piece with his chopsticks. A third man with long black hair is seen in the frame reacting to the scene, his mouth slightly agape in anticipation of the food. (7) The third man eats a piece, and through visual editing, it appears as though an octopus tentacle is protruding from his nostril while he smiles. The background shows blurred restaurant signage and refrigerated glass cases filled with bottles.
